# intro


```{r setup, results = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

wave <- "wave1"
atlas_roi_nm <- "glasser2016__parcel"
#atlas_roi_nm <- "schaefer2018_17_200__parcel"
#atlas_roi_nms <- c("glasser2016__superparcel", "glasser2016__parcel", "schaefer2018_17_200__parcel")

if (exists("params")) {
  suffix <- params$suffix
} else {
  suffix <- "__nresamp100__lsall_1rpm__divnormed__demeaned__centered"
}

## libraries

library(here)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mfutils)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegExtra)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(broom)
library(parallel)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
library(brms)

source(here("src", "stroop-rsa-pc.R"))

## settings
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))

theme_surface <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.5, 0.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    legend.background = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.height = unit(1/5, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(1/4, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
)
theme_basic <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
)

colors_model <- c(
  target = "#1b9e77",
  congruency = "#d95f02",
  distractor = "#7570b3"
)

colors_session <- c(
  baseline = "#1f78b4",
  proactive = "#b2df8a",
  reactive = "#a6cee3"
)


## constants

stimsets <- c("bias", "pc50", "biaspc50")
models <- c("target", "distractor", "congruency")
path_data <- here("out", "decoding")
subjdirs <- list.dirs(path_data)[-1]
path_data <- here("out", "decoding")
fname <- paste0("trainbaseline__", wave, "__svm__", atlas_roi_nm, suffix, "_summarized.RDS")
does_exist <- file.exists(file.path(subjdirs, fname))
subjdirs <- subjdirs[does_exist]
subjs <- gsub(".*decoding/", "", subjdirs)

subset_nms <- c("bias", "pc50", "biaspc50")
names(ttypes)[names(ttypes) == "all"] <- "biaspc50"

## data
l <- mclapply(subjdirs, function(x) readRDS(file.path(x, fname)), mc.cores = 20)
d <- rbindlist(l)

## add behavior:
beh <- fread(here("in", "behavior-and-events_stroop_2022-05-27_nice.csv"))
beh <- beh %>%
  group_by(subj, session, wave, run) %>%
  mutate(trial = trial_num + ifelse(session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), 108, 120) * (run - 1)) %>%
  select(wave, session, run, trial, subj, time_target_onset, rt, acc)
dat <- data.table::merge.data.table(d, beh, by = c("subj", "session", "wave", "trial"), all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(dat) == nrow(d))

## configure atlas:

atlas <- glasser
atlas$data <- atlas$data %>% filter(region != "H")  ## remove HC from atlas, b/c not in data!

dat[, region := gsub("L_|R_", "", roi)]
dat[, hemi := ifelse(grepl("L_", roi), "left", "right")]
dat <- dat[!(region %in% c("10pp") & hemi == "left")]  ## not in glasser ggseg atlas?
dat[, region_hemi := paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region)]
k <- glasser2016_fsaverage5$key %>% 
  select(region = parcel, network) %>%
  mutate(region = gsub("L_|R_", "", region))
dat[, network := k$network[match(region, k$region)]]

## add test_stimset:
dat[, test_stimset := ""]
dat[stimulus %in% ttypes$bias, test_stimset := "bias"]
dat[stimulus %in% ttypes$pc50, test_stimset := "pc50"]

## subject lists

subjs_table <- as.data.table(table(dat$subj, dat$wave, dat$session) > 0)
names(subjs_table) <- c("subj", "wave", "session", "has_data")
subjs_wave1 <- subjs_table %>%
  filter(wave == "wave1") %>%
  group_by(subj) %>%
  summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 3) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>%
  pull(subj)
subjs_wave2 <- subjs_table %>%
  group_by(subj) %>%
  summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 6) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>%
  pull(subj)


```


# brains: summary statistics


```{r}

## per session

dat_subj <- dat[
  ,
  list(
    t_stat = t.test(evidence)$statistic,
    p = t.test(evidence, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(evidence)
  ),
  by = c(
    "subj", "session", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network"
    )
]

dat_group <- dat_subj[
  ,
  list(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ),
  by = c("session", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]

dat_group[,
  p_fdr := p.adjust(p, "fdr"),
  by = c("session", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]


## average over session

dat_subj_marg <- dat_subj[
  ,
  list(b = mean(b)),
  by = c(
    "subj", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network"
    )
]

dat_group_marg <- dat_subj_marg[
  ,
  list(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ),
  by = c("wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]

dat_group_marg[,
  p_fdr := p.adjust(p, "fdr"),
  by = c("wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]



## contrast across session

dat_subj_cont <- dat_subj  %>%
  select(-t_stat, -p) %>%
  pivot_wider(
      id_cols =
        c("subj", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network"),
      names_from = "session",
      values_from = "b"
    ) %>%
    mutate(pr = proactive - reactive) %>%
    as.data.table

dat_group_cont <- dat_subj_cont[
  ,
  list(
    t_stat = t.test(pr)$statistic,
    p = t.test(pr)$p.value,
    b = mean(pr)
  ),
  by = c("wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]

dat_group_cont[,
  p_fdr := p.adjust(p, "fdr"),
  by = c("wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network")
]


# dat_group_cont[p < 0.05 & variable == "target" & train_stimset == "bias" & test_stimset == "bias" & t_stat > 0]
# dat_group_cont[p < 0.05 & variable == "target" & train_stimset == "bias" & test_stimset == "bias" & t_stat < 0]

# dat_group_cont[p < 0.05 & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "bias" & test_stimset == "bias" & t_stat > 0]
# dat_group_cont[p < 0.05 & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "bias" & test_stimset == "bias" & t_stat < 0]

# dat_group[region_hemi == "L_9-46d" & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "pc50" & test_stimset == "pc50"]
# dat_group[region_hemi == "L_IP0" & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "pc50" & test_stimset == "pc50"]

# dat_group[region_hemi == "L_9-46d" & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "pc50" & test_stimset == "pc50"]
# dat_group[region_hemi == "L_IP0" & variable == "distractor" & train_stimset == "pc50" & test_stimset == "pc50"]

```

## per session

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

for (stimset in stimsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n", stimset))

  for (model in models) {

    if (stimset == "biaspc50") {
      if (model != "congruency") next
      test_stimset_nm <- c("bias", "pc50")
    } else {
      test_stimset_nm <- stimset
    }

    p <-
      dat_group %>%
      filter(variable == model, train_stimset == stimset, test_stimset %in% test_stimset_nm) %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas,
        position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      theme_surface +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(session)) +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", stimset), fill = "t")

    print(p)

  }
}

```

## contrast across sessions


```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

for (stimset in stimsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n", stimset))

  for (model in models) {

    if (stimset == "biaspc50") {
      if (model != "congruency") next
      #test_stimset_nm <- c("bias", "pc50")
      test_stimset_nm <- "pc50"
    } else {
      test_stimset_nm <- stimset
    }

    rois_sig <- dat_group_marg[
      p_fdr < 0.05 & variable == model & train_stimset == stimset & test_stimset == test_stimset_nm,
      region_hemi
      ]

    p <-
      dat_group_cont %>%
      filter(variable == model, train_stimset == stimset, test_stimset %in% test_stimset_nm) %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(p < 0.05 & region_hemi %in% rois_sig, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas,
        position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      theme_surface +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", stimset), fill = "t")

    print(p)

  }
}

```


# brains: HLMs

```{r}

path_name <- paste0("trainbaseline__", wave, "__svm__", atlas_roi_nm, suffix, "_summarized")
paths <- here("out", "decoding", "_group", path_name, paste0(models, "_pc50"))
files <- list.files(paths, full.names = TRUE)
res <- lapply(files, 
  function(filename, hyps) {
    x <- readRDS(filename)
    hypothesis(x, hyps)
  },
  hyps = c("sessionproactive > 0", "sessionreactive > 0", "sessionproactive - sessionreactive = 0")
)
names(res) <- paste0(
  gsub("(.*)(L_.*|R_.*)", "\\2", files), 
  "__",
  gsub("(.*)(target|distractor|congruency)(.*)", "\\2", files)
)
hyps <- res %>%
  lapply("[[", "hypothesis") %>%
  lapply(as.data.table) %>%
  rbindlist(idcol = "id") %>%
  separate(id, c("roi", "model"), sep = "__")

hyps[Hypothesis == "(sessionproactive) > 0", Hypothesis := "proactive"]
hyps[Hypothesis == "(sessionreactive) > 0", Hypothesis := "reactive"]
hyps[Hypothesis == "(sessionproactive-sessionreactive) = 0", Hypothesis := "p-r"]

hyps %>%
  filter(Hypothesis %in% c("proactive", "reactive")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(roi, Estimate, fill = Hypothesis)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 1/2), width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI.Lower, ymax = CI.Upper), position = position_dodge(width = 1/2), width = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(model)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_session) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs("Proactive and Reactive sessions")
ggsave("main_effects.pdf", height = 12, width = 8, dev = "pdf")

hyps %>%
  filter(Hypothesis %in% c("p-r")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(roi, Estimate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI.Lower, ymax = CI.Upper), width = 1/3) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(model)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs("Proactive - Reactive")
ggsave("contrast.pdf", height = 12, width = 8, dev = "pdf")

```

# ROI profiles

## MD regions


```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_md <- dat_subj %>% filter(region %in% md$core, test_stimset == "pc50", train_stimset == "pc50")

dat_md_sorted <- dat_md %>%
  filter(wave == "wave1", session == "proactive") %>%
  group_by(variable, train_stimset, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(variable, train_stimset) %>%
  arrange(-b)

for (model in models) {

  p <- dat_md %>%

    filter(variable == model) %>%
    mutate(
      region_hemi = paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region),
      region_hemi = factor(
        region_hemi,
        levels = dat_md_sorted %>% filter(variable == model) %>% pull(region_hemi)
        )
    ) %>%

    ggplot(aes(region_hemi, b, color = session)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = session), size = 1.5) +

    scale_color_manual(values = colors_session) +
    theme_basic +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.90, 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
      ) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(wave)) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(model, " pc50"), x = "core MD region", y = "mean RSA model fit", color = NULL,
      caption = "regions sorted by mean coef in baseline wave1"
      )

  print(p)

}


```
